items.title: Football Drops Game at Louisiana Tech Saturday
items.summary: RUSTON, La. -- Southern Miss showed flashes of offensive promise and finished with a burst Saturday afternoon, but four interceptions and a 42-point first half for the Bulldogs proved too much to overcome in a 63-31 loss to Louisiana Tech at Joe Aillet Stadium.

items.title: Steven Robinson Named Sun Belt Conference Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: HATTIESBURG, Miss. – Southern Miss redshirt junior running back Steven Robinson (Baltimore, Md.) earned the Sun Belt Conference Offensive Player of the Week honors Monday after helping lead his Golden Eagles to a 35-21 victory at ULM last Saturday.

items.title: Football Defeats ULM Saturday Afternoon 35-21 in Sun Belt Action
items.summary: MONROE, La. -- Steven Robinson ran for 151 yards and a touchdown, Jamarice Wilder added 104 yards and two scores, and Southern Miss held off ULM 35-21 on Saturday after the Warhawks trimmed a 20-point deficit in the fourth quarter.
